sections.html:
• Scientific name: Hypostomus aff. pusarum
  • Common names: L078, Parnaiba Pleco
  • Etymology: Greek, hypo = under + Greek, stoma = mouth.
  • IUCN Red List: Not Evaluated
Brazil, Maranhão, Rio Parnaiba drainage, Piauí Rivers, Parnaíba.
Breeding: unreported. There is no breeding report.
